content.text: The bug is in the legacy `potion_health` archetype: fountain dipping correctly adds `Beatitude: cursed`, but the drink path has no item hook for that identity, so the normal regeneration is the only effect. I’m keeping the good part of the potion intact and adding a short, deterministic “lagging shadow” curse: the drink still heals, then briefly confuses movement and emits a quiet warning.
